description: This file defines functions and classes related to mapping PyTorch API functions to reference implementations (_refs), managing prim functions, and overriding torch functions to use reference implementations within a context manager.

classes.name: TorchRefsMode
classes.description: A context manager that overrides torch functions to use reference implementations (_refs) for the duration of the context, with options for strictness and fallback behavior.

methods.name: torch_to_refs_map
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping torch API functions to their corresponding _refs functions, supporting remapping and conversions.

methods.name: all_prims
methods.description: Returns a set of all primitive functions in torch._prims.
